_comment: Deck -> strategic archetype tags. Keys are deck stems relative to
bin/resources/decks/ (no '.dk'), exactly as decks are referenced on the
command line (e.g. 'league/ur_delver'). Values must be one of the
archetypes listed in train/archetypes.py (ARCHETYPES); an unmapped deck
falls back to the 'unknown' bucket, EXCEPT for league roster decks, which
must all be tagged here (train.py league() validates the roster loudly).
